NDT software in Bakersfield: built for oilfield, pipeline and plant inspection crews

NDT software in Bakersfield has to handle work that looks very different from a coastal refinery contract. Kern County is still California's oil county, and most inspection hours here go into producing fields, thermal operations, gathering lines, tank batteries and the plants that support them. The Atlantis ERP solution gives a Bakersfield NDT contractor one system for technician certifications, instrument calibration, crew dispatch, field reports, quoting and invoicing.

The local market is familiar to anyone who has worked it. Fields such as Midway-Sunset, Kern River, Belridge, Elk Hills and Lost Hills run steamflood and cyclic steam operations with miles of surface piping, steam generators, separators and storage tanks. Large operators including Chevron, California Resources Corporation and Berry run ongoing integrity programs, and there is refining and renewable-fuels processing in and around the city. Add the pipeline operators, the cogeneration plants, the food and agricultural processors along Highway 99, and the aerospace test community at Edwards and Mojave in eastern Kern, and a Bakersfield inspection company can be doing UT thickness surveys on steam lines on Monday and PT on a machined aerospace fitting on Thursday.

The typical Bakersfield NDT contractor is a small-to-mid-sized firm: a handful of Level IIs, one Level III either in-house or contracted, a pickup fleet, a rack of UT flaw detectors and thickness gauges, a radiography crew or two, and a lot of work that gets called in the afternoon before. Regulators set the tone. CalGEM oversees well and production facility integrity, Cal/OSHA enforces workplace safety including radiography work practices, and state and air district rules shape how facilities are maintained. The ERP does not manage any of those regimes for you, but every one of them expects a contractor to show who did the work, with what equipment, under which procedure. That paper trail is exactly what the Atlantis ERP keeps.

ERP for NDT companies in Bakersfield: what it actually replaces

An ERP for NDT companies in Bakersfield replaces the spreadsheet of cert expiry dates, the whiteboard of who is on which lease, the shared drive full of report templates and the accounting package that never quite matches the field tickets. The Atlantis ERP puts all of it in one database, so a job, the technicians on it, the instruments they carried and the invoice all point to each other.

For an oilfield-heavy contractor that link matters. When an operator's integrity group asks for the calibration certificate of the gauge used on a steam line survey eight months ago, or a pipeline client wants the Level II certificate of the RT technician who shot a tie-in weld, the answer should take seconds, not an afternoon digging through email. In the Atlantis ERP each NDT report carries the work order, request, WPS, contract and drawing numbers plus procedure and standard references, and the technicians and equipment serial numbers are recorded against the job.

The apps that matter most for a Bakersfield shop are NDT Reports, Certificates, Procedures, Team Assignments, Asset Management, Quotations, Invoicing, Timesheets, Fleet and CRM. The full list is on the ERP apps overview. Everything is configured to your methods, clients and paperwork during implementation, so you are not bending an inspection business to fit a manufacturing ERP.

Technician certification tracking software for Kern County crews

Technician certification tracking software should tell you, before dispatch, whether the person you are sending is qualified for that method and level today. The Atlantis ERP Certificates app computes that status automatically and starts warning you 90 days before anything lapses.

Each certification records the scheme (SNT-TC-1A, CP-189, ISO 9712, PCN, CSWIP or other), level from trainee to Level III, method, certifying body, issue, expiry and renewal dates, industry sector, OJT hours, training hours and exam results, with the certificate file attached. Status is shown as active, expiring soon, expired or revoked, and there are ready-made Expiring Soon and Expired menus. Vision tests are tracked on their own: Jaeger J1/J2 near vision, far vision, colour perception and contrast, with examiner, clinic, certificate file and expiry.

In Bakersfield this matters because technicians rotate between operators and each operator's contractor-management system wants current paperwork. The employee NDT profile also holds radiation safety training, radiation badge number and medical fitness expiry, which your RT crews need on file. Daily checks raise warning tasks ahead of cert and vision-test expiry, configurable email alerts go to whoever you choose, and Timesheets warns when someone logs hours while their certificate is not valid. Examination sheets store general, specific and practical scores against a configurable passing score, so your written practice evidence sits next to the cert. Details are on the Certificates app page.

Calibration management software for gauges, flaw detectors and RT equipment

Calibration management software for a Bakersfield NDT company needs to catch an out-of-calibration gauge before it leaves the yard, not after the report is signed. The Atlantis ERP Asset Management app tracks every instrument by serial number and warns the dispatcher when assigned equipment is out of calibration.

Oilfield thickness work runs through a lot of gauges and probes, and they get knocked about on lease roads. Each item records equipment type, asset tag, firmware, accessories, assigned person, condition and a lifecycle state: new, active, in calibration, in repair, rented out, retired or disposed. Calibration records hold the provider, certificate number, standard, range, uncertainty, accredited-lab flag, pass/fail/conditional result and next due date. The calibration certificate register stores the lab accreditation number and PDF, flags valid, expiring and expired certificates and sends expiry alerts.

Issue and return runs through supervisor and manager approval, with condition recorded both ways, so the cracked transducer cable that came back from Taft is on record against the person and the job. Reservations stop two crews claiming the same phased array unit for the same week. Consumables such as couplant, MT particles, penetrant, developer and PPE carry reorder levels and low-stock flags, and the maintenance log covers preventive, corrective, repair, cleaning, firmware updates and probe replacement. For radiography, the Fleet app records which trucks can carry radioactive sources along with the transport licence number and expiry. See Asset Management.

Crew dispatch software for leases, plants and shutdowns

Crew dispatch software in Bakersfield has to cope with short-notice call-outs spread across a very large county. Atlantis Team Assignments runs each job through planned, dispatched, in field, submitted and closed, and blocks double-booking of both technicians and instrument serial numbers.

Each job records site GPS coordinates, which helps when the location is a lease road off Highway 33 rather than a street address, plus mobilisation and demobilisation dates. The technician availability calendar shows assigned, leave, training, sick and unavailable days and blocks overlaps; approved Time Off feeds straight into it. Each technician shows current assignment, utilisation and next available date. When an operator calls late in the day wanting a UT crew in McKittrick at first light, you can see in one screen who is free, who holds the right certification and which calibrated gauge is on the shelf.

Calendar, kanban and list views suit different people in the office. When a steam generator outage or a plant turnaround pulls several technicians for weeks, the Project app holds the scope, client PO, contract, methods, codes, acceptance criteria, assigned equipment and technicians, and the safety induction and work permit fields that operators ask about at the gate. See Team Assignments.

NDT reporting software that works where the signal does not

NDT reporting software should let a technician finish the report on site, even with no signal, and get it approved without retyping. The Atlantis field app is an installable web app that works offline, stores drafts and photos on the device and syncs when the truck gets back into coverage.

That offline point is not theoretical in western Kern County. The system covers 17 report types including UT, RT, MT, PT, VT, PAUT, TOFD, MFL, PMI, hardness, UT thickness, holiday/coating and computed radiography, each with its own numbering sequence. UT thickness readings are captured by direction; RT reports record source, technique, IQI type and placement; weld and job lines capture defect type and orientation; the overall result is acceptable, not acceptable or acceptable with remarks. Reports move through draft, in progress, review, approved and sent, with inspector, reviewer and approver signatures and a third-party or authorized inspector signature where the client requires one.

If an operator insists on its own spreadsheet format, Excel templates are filled automatically by mapping fields to cells, and versioned company templates in Excel, Word, PDF or HTML carry your logo, header and footer. For clients who want to see results on the asset rather than in a PDF, Digital Twin Reporting Software and Atlantis Digital Twins show indications and thickness trends on a 3D model. See NDT Reports.

Procedure control for your Level III

Bakersfield contractors often work to both their own procedures and the operator's, and keeping revisions straight is a Level III headache. The Procedures app keeps a register with document number, revision, method, scope, material, applicable standard such as ASME Section V, acceptance criteria and the body text or uploaded file.

Procedures move through draft, submitted, reviewed, approved and published, with prepared, reviewed and approved by names and dates. Approved revisions are locked, rejections carry a reason, and every revision is kept as a snapshot, so you can show which revision was in force on the day a report was issued. An AI-assisted first draft saves typing on a new UT or MT procedure, and your Level III still reviews and approves it. Approvers get email reminders for anything pending. See Procedures.

NDT quoting and invoicing software for oilfield service billing

NDT quoting and invoicing software for Bakersfield has to bill the way oilfield work actually runs: day rates, standby, travel, equipment and consumables, often against an operator PO and a field ticket. The Atlantis Quotations, Timesheets and Invoicing apps are set up for exactly that.

Quotes carry job type, site, project dates and applicable codes, with NDT service products flagged by method and category, a global discount and a branded quotation PDF; the client can accept and sign online and the quote converts to a sales order. Timesheets record work type (inspection, travel, standby, setup), method, billable flag, rate multiplier, site, client and equipment serial, with approval, so standby hours waiting on a permit do not disappear. Invoices carry the NDT project, job or PO number, site, invoice type and industry sector, with separate subtotals for labour, equipment and consumables, and lines that show cost centre, method, equipment serial, technician, rate type and days or hours. Field expenses and per diems come through Expenses and can be re-billed to the job. The financial dashboard shows revenue, cost of sales, gross margin, operating expenses, EBITDA and outstanding invoices over twelve months. See Quotations and Invoicing.

Inspection management software in Bakersfield: winning and keeping operator work

Inspection management software is only half the job if the sales side lives in someone's phone. The Atlantis CRM records service line, lead source, NDT service type, industry sector, site country and estimated technicians and days, and scores each lead from 0 to 100 as hot, warm, nurture or cold.

For a Bakersfield firm trying to spread risk beyond a few big operators, that helps you work the cogeneration plants, food processors, water districts and renewable-fuels projects in a structured way. Leads import from CSV, the Business Cards app turns a photo of a card from a safety meeting or trade night into a CRM lead, and AI-drafted drip emails by service line keep you in front of maintenance planners. KPI dashboards show certs expiring, calibration due or overdue and issued equipment overdue for return. See CRM and Dashboards.

Affordable customizable ERP for inspection companies in Bakersfield

An affordable customizable ERP for inspection companies in Bakersfield means you get NDT-specific apps without paying for a large-enterprise rollout, and the system is shaped to your forms rather than the other way round. Atlantis quotes each implementation on request, based on the apps and integrations you actually need.

Small NDT companies usually start with Certificates, Asset Management, Team Assignments and NDT Reports, then add Quotations, Invoicing and CRM once the field side is stable. If you already run QuickBooks or NetSuite, or an operator wants data pushed into SAP or Maximo, the open REST API connects to any system that accepts API connections, scoped per implementation. Ask for a quote for your Bakersfield team.

Implementing the Atlantis ERP in Bakersfield

Implementation is run remotely by Atlantis NDT, led by founder Anoop Rayavarapu, an ASNT NDT Level III, so the people configuring your system understand written practices, method-specific reports and calibration evidence. A typical sequence for a Bakersfield contractor looks like this:

  1. Load your people and paperwork. Technicians, certifications, vision tests and radiation badge details go in first, so expiry alerts start working straight away.
  2. Load your instruments. Every gauge, flaw detector, probe and RT item by serial number, with the latest calibration certificates and due dates.
  3. Rebuild your report formats. Your UT thickness, RT and MT forms, or the operator's own Excel sheets, are mapped into templates.
  4. Set up dispatch. Clients, sites and GPS coordinates for your regular leases and plants, with the availability calendar.
  5. Connect billing. Rate types, standby and travel rules and cost centres, plus any accounting integration configured during implementation.
  6. Train the crews. Technicians install the offline field app and run a few live jobs with support.

If you also want to build in-house technician training, Atlantis offers ASNT SNT-TC-1A-based NDT training and an eLearning portal with Level I, II and III sections, plus the Practical NDT 3D simulator. Talk to us about an implementation plan.

Frequently asked questions

What is the best NDT software for small NDT companies in Bakersfield?

The best fit is one system that covers certifications, calibration, dispatch, reports and billing together. The Atlantis ERP is built for NDT and inspection companies and is configured to your methods and forms, so a small Kern County shop does not need several separate tools.

Does the field app work on leases with no cell coverage?

Yes. The installable field app stores drafts and photos on the device and syncs later, with method picker, photo capture, on-screen signature and PDF preview.

Can it track radiography crews' badges and source vehicles?

Yes. Employee NDT profiles store radiation safety training, badge number and medical fitness expiry, and Fleet records which vehicles can carry radioactive sources plus transport licence number and expiry.

Does the ERP do engineering assessments for operators?

No. The ERP records UT thickness readings in reports and manages your business; engineering assessment of the results stays with the operator's integrity team. Atlantis does offer API 510, 570 and 653 inspection services separately through inspection services.

Can it connect to our accounting system?

Yes. The open REST API integrates with QuickBooks, NetSuite, SAP, Maximo or any system that accepts API connections, scoped per implementation.

How much does it cost?

Pricing is quoted on request based on the apps, users and integrations you need. The positioning is simple: affordable, accessible and fully customizable.
